description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named `AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams` used for filtering attendance record searches within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It manages parameters such as employee numbers and date ranges, and sets default sorting options.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for specifying filtering and sorting criteria for attendance record searches, including employee numbers and date ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting by 'attendanceRecord.punchInUserTime' in descending order.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers to filter attendance records.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date for filtering attendance records.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for filtering attendance records.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date for filtering attendance records.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for filtering attendance records.
